# demo-android

The Android (Shield) demo application.

A app.

- **Uses:** `ac3`, `audio`, `base`, `containers`
- **Used by:** nothing
- **CI lanes:** android

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
ctest --preset test-linux-gcc -L demo-android
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build; `ctest -L` runs this project's tests alone.
